style: clean: dry, close-mic'd, crisp, no reverb, no background noise, no music, game-ready one-shot

click.p: Short soft UI button click for a retro adventure game, crisp and dry

beep.p: A single clean high-pitched electronic beep, dry

scan.p: Handheld barcode scanner successful scan: two quick ascending beeps, dry

scanfail.p: Handheld scanner error: two descending low buzzy tones, dry

pickup.p: Item pickup chime: two quick rising bright notes, dry

reverse.p: Forklift reverse warning beeper: four evenly spaced loud beeps, nothing else

dock.p: A trailer backing into a loading dock: heavy thud against rubber bumper and a short metallic clank

bump.p: Dull heavy bump of a large object hitting a wall, low thud

pallet.p: A wooden pallet set down on a concrete floor, short wooden clunk

printer.p: Dot matrix office printer printing a short burst, quick mechanical zipping

radio.p: Walkie-talkie squelch click then two quick chirps

buzz.p: Low flat electrical error buzzer, one sustained tone

vend.p: Vending machine dispensing: coin clunk, mechanical whirr, snack dropping into the tray

bark.p: A single bark from a medium-sized dog, close microphone

meow.p: A single short domestic cat meow

meows.p: A chorus of many cats meowing together

card.p: Short bright title-card fanfare: four rising retro synth notes

mint.p: A magical shimmering ascending glissando with a soft glow tone ending in a bright ping, sci-fi

fail.p: Sad game-over descending four-note synth fall

win.p: Cheerful short victory fanfare of ascending synth notes

kpi.p: Two quick soft computer data blips, dry
